conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Maya from the Amazon Legal Department. I'm calling regarding an urgent concern linked to your Amazon account, reference policy code AMZ-4421B. May I speak with Ms. Lina, please?
Yes, is Lina. What is problem with my account?
Thank you, Ms. Lina. For your protection, before we continue, can you confirm your registered email address so I can verify your identity as per Amazon's security policy?
My email is linawang88@gmail.com.

Perfect, thank you. The reason for my call is that we detected a suspicious attempt to purchase a MacBook Pro from your account just now. To ensure your account is secure, I need to ask you a few questions. Please do not worry, we will resolve this together.
I do not buy MacBook. That not me! What I do?
Don't worry, we can stop the unauthorized purchase and make sure your money is safe. Can you please confirm the last four digits of your phone number on your Amazon profile?
Last four is 2179.
Thank you for confirming. According to policy AMZ-4421B, if unauthorized activity occurs, we must temporarily freeze your account and begin the refund process. I will help you step by step.
Okay, please help me. I not good with computer.
Of course, I'll explain everything clearly. To secure your account and process the reversal, are you currently near a laptop or smartphone with internet access?
Yes, my phone here.
Excellent. For your safety, Amazon now requires all refund verifications be completed through our secure portal. Please open your internet browser and go to www.amz-customer-support.com.
It hard for me to type, is that Amazon real site?
I understand your concern, Ms. Lina. This is our secure customer service portal for urgent cases, as mentioned in our policy. I'll stay on the line with you the entire time to guide you.
Okay, I try now. It load page, ask for code.
Perfect. I will provide you the one-time verification code: 348552. Please enter that when prompted.
I enter code. Now page ask for Amazon login?
Yes, please enter your Amazon login so our system can verify the correct account for the refund. Don't worry, your information is protected under policy AMZ-4421B.
I put my email and password. What next?
Thank you, Ms. Lina. Now, to process the refund of $1,299 for the MacBook charge, our protocol requires us to verify your refund account. Do you have access to your online banking app?
Yes, I have bank app. But my English not so good, can you wait?
Of course, take your time. I'm here to assist you every step. Once you are logged in, let me know.
Okay, I am in my bank app.

Great job. For a secure refund, our system will temporarily transfer the amount. Sometimes, due to a system glitch, extra funds can be deposited. If that happens, we'll guide you to return only the extra portion. This is a standard Amazon process.
I understand. You help me if problem, right?
Absolutely. If any unexpected amount appears, I will help you correct it immediately. Now, please confirm, do you see a recent deposit in your bank account?
Oh, it say $5,299 from Amazon Refund. Is too much! Why?

That looks like the system glitch I mentioned. You were only supposed to receive $1,299. The extra $4,000 must be returned for compliance reasons. Amazon is required to keep precise accounting records.
How I send money back? I never do before.

No problem, I will guide you. For security and speed, please purchase Amazon gift cards totaling $4,000 at your nearest store. Once you have them, I'll tell you how to provide the codes for the refund process.
Gift card? Is safe? I not sure.

Yes, this is the safest and fastest way for Amazon to correct accidental refunds. It's a temporary measure, and your account will be fully restored after we receive the codes. I assure you, you are protected under Amazon policy AMZ-4421B.
Okay, I will go store now. I get cards and call back?
Thank you for cooperating, Ms. Lina. Please stay on the line for your convenience. Once you have the gift cards, just read the numbers on the back to me, and the system will complete your refund.
